description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) Developer to join an international technology team working on innovative digital solutions.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing, customising, and enhancing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE solutions, with a particular focus on Dynamics 365 Sales. You will collaborate with business stakeholders and technical specialists to translate business requirements into scalable, efficient, and user-friendly CRM solutions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong Dynamics 365 professional who enjoys hands-on development, solution design, and working in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, customise, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE solutions, particularly Dynamics 365 Sales.

  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and scalable CRM solutions.

  • Develop and implement custom extensions, plugins, integrations, and additional functionalities.

  • Prepare technical estimates and assess the feasibility of proposed solutions.

  • Ensure code quality, maintainability, scalability, and compliance with development standards.

  • Work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, technical standards, and best practices.

  • Support the implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of CRM solutions.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Based in Romania.

  • Several years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE / Dynamics 365 Sales development.

  • Strong programming skills in C# and .NET.

  • Good knowledge of TypeScript, HTML, and Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Experience developing and customising CRM solutions, including integrations and extensions.

  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.

  • Very good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform.

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Scrum frameworks.

  • Experience working in DevOps environments and modern software development teams.
